title: private-deploy-daily-scratchpad-aisha
content:
Daily scratchpad: Private deploys (VPC / on-prem) - notes + TODOs

2026-03-02 - quick log
- Started with customer ACME Corp (on-prem) prep call 09:00. Confirmed network team contact: Maria L. (maria@acme.example).
- Biggest known blocker: customer uses strict outbound proxy + internal image registry that requires auth via corp SSO. Need image pull secret + proxy env injected into systemd/daemon.
- Verified that their K8s control plane is 1.24 (supported but need to pin chart compatibility). Node OS: RHEL 8.6 with Docker engine 20.10 (we prefer containerd; need to validate runtime).
- Action: create a lightweight patch for helm values to set http_proxy/https_proxy and imagePullSecrets, add to PR template.

Install checklist (working)
1) Pre-reqs (customer must confirm):
   - Open outbound ports: 443, 5222 (agent heartbeat), 9000 (optional metrics endpoint). Confirmed customer firewall team will allow 443 and 5222 through NAT gateway.
   - DNS: internal DNS must resolve our control-plane FQDN (private-control.redwood.internal) or we provide static /etc/hosts entries.
   - NTP configured on all nodes (critical for certs).
   - KMS/Vault access: customer to provide access path or we use customer-managed KMS.
   - Proxy: provide proxy URL and credentials (we support basic + NTLM via socks proxy; note: NTLM needs extra setup).
2) Node sizing suggestions:
   - Control plane: 2 x m5.xlarge (~16GB) for small installs; for GPU workloads, dedicate 1-2 GPU nodes of validated type.
   - Disk: 100GB recommended for logs and images unless they have local registry.
3) Software versions we verify before helm deploy:
   - Kubernetes >=1.23, <=1.25 for current chart; if 1.26 need to use chart v2.0.
   - Container runtime: containerd preferred; if Docker, ensure dockerd >=19.03.
   - Kernel drivers: for GPU customers ensure NVIDIA driver >=470 and matching CUDA toolkit on nodes.
4) Secrets & certs:
   - We need CA certs if customer terminates TLS at proxy.
   - Image registry creds: we will generate imagePullSecret template.
   - TLS: we provide instructions for cert-manager or manual secret injection.

Known blockers / gotchas (from past installs)
- Air-gapped networks: need prior shipment of images + offline helm repo tarball. Ask infra for image export script (docker save + tar) and manifest.
- Proxy that does TLS interception: cert pinning might fail; ask customer to whitelist control-plane certs or provide corporate CA.
- SSO-protected registries: need service account with scoped registry token; SAML flows do not work for automation.
- Incompatible CNI (older calico versions): some network policy rules blocked agent heartbeat; recommend calico >=3.15 or flannel.
- SELinux enforced on RHEL can block write to mounted volumes if not using proper context; provide example SELinux policy or recommend setenforce=Permissive for install window.

TODOs (short-term)
- A: Create helm-values example for proxy + imagePullSecrets (owner: Aisha) - target 2026-03-05.
- B: Draft checklist for on-prem runbook focused on air-gapped installs (owner: Diego) - target 2026-03-10.
- C: Open PR to add RHEL/Selinux notes to docs (owner: Riley) - Jira PD-4827.
- D: Confirm GPU driver installer script compatibility with RHEL 8.6 (owner: SRE) - create follow-up ticket PD-4832.

Customer env reminders (per-account)
- ACME Corp: uses internal registry registry.acme.corp:5000, requires cert / auth via corp LDAP. Contact Maria for test creds.
- Beta Retailer: heavy egress cost concerns -> prefer dedicated VPC peering to avoid NAT costs. Discuss Dedicated offering.
- MedHealth: HIPAA - audit logs retention policy must be 7 years; will enable extended retention add-on.

Notes to self
- Keep field notes light during calls. Push concrete next-steps into Jira while on call.
- Remember to ask about disaster recovery window and backup of DB (if they want local Postgres).
- Add step to verify MTU on customer network (high MTU sometimes breaks large image pulls).

Useful links / quick refs:
- Confluence runbook (internal): PRIVATE-DEPLOY-RUNBOOK-12345 (linked above)
- Internal image export script: github.com/redwood-inference/tools/image-export (ask infra for access)
- Ticket tracker: JIRA PD-4821 (ACME initial onboarding)

End of scratchpad entry for 2026-03-02.

-- Aisha
